{{AnimePokémonInfobox |nickname=Costa |jnickname=ゴーラ |tmnickname=Goura |image=[[File:Black Costa.png|250px]] |caption=Costa |location=[[Nimbasa City]] (by {{adv|Black}}) |gender=Male |ability={{a|Solid Rock}} |type1=Water |type2=Rock |nature=Calm |media=special |evolution=1 |numeps1=17 |firststagename=Tirtouga |pokemonname=Carracosta |epnum=PS488 |epname=Growing Pains |firstevoep=PS505 |firstevoname=A Cold Reception |released=yes |releaseep=PS488 |releasename=Prior to Growing Pains |prevonum=564 |evo1num=565 |current=[[Party|With Black]] |va=no }} '''Costa''' (Japanese: '''ゴーラ''' ''Goura'') is a {{p|Carracosta}} that {{adv|Black}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his fifth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. He originally belonged to [[Marshal]] before being released due to his stubborn nature. As of ''[[PS521|The Power of Dreams]]'', he is at [[level]] 45, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "thoroughly cunning." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Black & White}}=== [[File:Marshal Tirtouga Adventures.png|thumb|left|150px|Tirtouga and Marshal]] Costa first appeared as a Tirtouga in ''[[PS488|Growing Pains]]'' as a [[wild Pokémon]] in [[Nimbasa City]]. Noticing that {{adv|White}} was struggling to capture a Pokémon, Black decided to catch Tirtouga to teach her what to do. Black then sent out [[Tula]] to weaken him and promptly caught him in a {{i|Poké Ball}}. After the capture [[Marshal]] reveals that he had previously owned Tirtouga but {{pkmn2|released}} him due to his extremely stubborn nature. In ''[[PS492|Mine Mayhem]]'', Black attempted to bond with Tirtouga with some training, but Tirtouga ignored his {{pkmn|Trainer}} and swam away. When Black attempted to get him to listen, an assistant of [[Clay]]'s came over and told him that Clay was ready to have a [[Gym]] battle, so Black hurries to the gym with Tirtouga in his arms. Upon arriving, Clay attacked Black and Tirtouga with his {{p|Krokorok}}'s {{m|Sand Tomb}}, whose attack irritated Tirtouga enough to counter-attack with {{m|Brine}}. Clay then sent out {{p|Palpitoad}} and had it attack with a powerful {{t|water}} attack and {{m|Hyper Voice}}, causing Tirtouga to cringe and retreat inside of his shell. Due to this, Clay sent out {{TP|Clay|Excadrill}} to drill against the shell with {{m|Drill Run}}, but the attack ended up dealing no damage at all. Although he did well, Black decided to save Costa for later and recalled him. He was later used as his final Pokémon to fight against Krokorok. Due to the lights in the Gym shutting off, Krokorok gained an immediate advantage due to being able to see in the dark and dealt heavy damage to Costa. When Krokorok was about to deal the final blow, Black imitated Costa's form, confusing Krokorok and causing it to miss. Using the opportunity, Costa attacked with Brine and knocked Krokorok out, earning Black the [[Quake Badge]]. [[File:Costa Solid Rock.png|thumb|200px|Solid Rock activated]] In ''[[PS495|The Battle Within]]'', Black used Costa as his second Pokémon in his fight against [[Skyla]], battling her {{TP|Skyla|Swanna}}. Black ordered Costa to use {{m|Ancient Power}}, but Costa simply looked at him annoyed. Frustrated, Black yelled at Costa about how important the battle was to him and Costa responded by attacking Swanna and knocking it out. Despite initially listening, he refused to do anything against her {{p|Unfezant}} and allowed himself to be defeated. In ''[[PS498|Decisions, Decisions]]'', Black was taken to the [[Tubeline Bridge]] for training under [[Brycen]]. Brycen had Costa train with his three {{p|Vanillish}}. Black was [[PS499|then]] tasked to defeat the {{tc|Biker|Black Empoleon biker gang}}, where Costa defeated the leader's {{p|Scraggy}} with a {{m|Hydro Pump}}. In ''[[PS504|The Cold Hard Truth]]'', Costa was sent out to battle Brycen's Vanillish and quickly defeated it with {{m|Scald}}. He next went up against his {{p|Beartic}}, who used its cold breath to freeze icicles onto its claws. Despite the increase in power, Beartic was unable to break Costa's defense and was sent flying away. Beartic then countered with {{m|Focus Blast}} and struck Costa in an unprotected spot, causing Costa to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Carracosta}}. Due to his increased size, Costa was able to overwhelm Beartic with his strength and win the battle for Black. [[File:Costa vs Iris Haxorus.png|thumb|left|200px|Costa in the Pokémon League]] In ''[[PS516|One Way or Another]]'', Black and Costa faced off against [[Iris]] and her {{p|Druddigon}} in the semifinals of the {{un|Pokémon League}}. Costa began attacking Druddigon with his long arms to keep the Cave Pokémon at a distance, but it failed when it stomped the ground repeatedly to attack with {{m|Bulldoze}}. However, thanks to Costa's {{a|Solid Rock}} [[Ability]], the damage from the attack was halved, forcing Iris to return it for {{TP|Iris|Haxorus}}, as it had {{a|Mold Breaker}} as its Ability. Haxorus slashed at Costa with its tusks, which Costa barely managed to block. Costa continued to block Haxorus's attacks until he eventually clamped his jaw onto Haxorus's tusk. Using his tail to balance himself, Costa lifted Haxorus upwards and fired an {{m|Ice Beam}} directly at it. The attack successfully froze Haxorus and defeated it, giving Black the win. During [[Team Plasma]]'s attack on the League in ''[[PS521|Triple Threat]]'', Costa, [[Musha]], [[Bo]], and Tula were sent out to help Black's allies fight against the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s causing havoc below. Once they finished fighting the Grunts, Costa and the rest of Black's team returned to their Trainer shortly after he defeated {{adv|N}}. The reunion was cut short when [[Ghetsis]] attacked Black in order to prevent the public from learning about N's defeat. With a team specifically designed to counter Black's, Ghetsis had the immediate advantage. With Musha's help, Black defeated Ghetsis by defeating his secret weapon, a {{p|Volcarona}}, and then unleashed a series of powerful attacks on Ghetsis's team. ==={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}=== In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', Costa worked alongside other {{type|Water}} Pokémon to try and put out the fire on [[N's Castle]]. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Black and Costa.png|thumb|right|150px|Costa and Black]] [[File:Costa ignoring Black.png|thumb|left|100px|Costa ignoring Black's commands]] When {{adv|Black}} first caught Costa, he was a very stubborn Pokémon who refused to follow orders, which was the reason [[Marshal]] {{pkmn2|released}} him in the first place. During their early days together, Costa showed annoyance and apathy towards his Trainer's attempt to bond with him. Over time, however, he began to trust Black and listen to him. After evolving, he became more serious and began to follow orders consistently.
